title: feat(studio): every human editor saves live; an item's unpublished AI changes can be dropped on its page (#36511, PR 3 of 3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TmfMWT7ctTvEhPrKWGwWUe)_

Fixes #36511

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 这是「改完直接点保存」专题的最后一个 PR：权限集、对象的访问总览、字段布局也改成右上角「取消/保存」，保存即生效，不再留草稿。
- 新建对象、流程、权限集时按钮写「创建」，建好就生效；其余仍存草稿的新建照旧写「存为草稿」。
- 对象和流程上有 AI 没发布的改动时，页面提示「这一项有 AI 未发布的改动，保存会一并生效」，并可「放弃 AI 的改动」，顶上「变更」数随之减少。
- 要你做的：无产品问题待裁；本卡全部验收条目在下表，PR 1 #36597、PR 2 #36634 已合并。

## What changes

PR 3 of 3 for the card. PR 1 (#36597) moved an object's fields, validations, actions and settings to the Studio top-bar Cancel/Save; PR 2 (#36634) moved hooks, an installed app's added actions, and flows. This PR finishes the list:

- **Permission sets** (`PermissionMatrixEditor`, inside Studio's Access pillar). Grants stay on the page until Save; Save writes the draft and publishes that one set at its package. A refused publish keeps the grant unsaved, says why, and takes back the draft it wrote. The full-metadata item page keeps its own buttons, as the card says.
- **OWD overview** (`PackageOwdOverviewPanel`). Its own "Save" button is gone; its rows register with the top-bar Save. Each changed object is saved as a draft and published at once. The controlled-by-parent prerequisite confirm still applies. Rows the server refuses stay edited and are named in the refusal; the rest are saved. When a later row asks the prerequisite, the rows already published are read back first, so none shows as unsaved and Cancel never restores a value the server no longer holds.
- **Field layout.** The form designer writes through the object's buffer that PR 1 put on Save/Cancel, so no code changed. A new suite pins it: moving a section sends nothing; Cancel restores the order; Save sends one draft PUT, then the publish.
- **Creates.** Creating an object, a flow or a permission set now publishes the new item right away, and those three dialogs say "Create" / 「创建」 (`engine.studio.createLive`). Every other create dialog still writes a draft and still says "Save as draft". `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787` pins which is which.
- **Item 6: an item with the AI's unpublished changes** (objects and flows). The page opens on the AI's version, as before. A line says 「这一项有 AI 未发布的改动，保存会一并生效」, with a 「放弃 AI 的改动」 button. The button discards that one item's draft at its package (`DELETE /meta/:type/:name?state=draft&package=`), never the package's batch discard. It asks first if the page has unsaved edits. The page goes back to the live version, and the Changes count re-reads the ledger, so it drops by that item. A draft a person wrote draws neither the line nor the button.
- **Changes count.** Live saves and the AI discard no longer report a "draft saved". That report held the count at one or more. They send the metadata refresh pulse instead, so the count reads the ledger again.

## Why

The maintainer ruled on 2026-11-22 that a human edit is saved and confirmed one item at a time. Drafts plus the batch publish stay for the AI. This PR moves the last human editors off the draft autosave and adds the card's item 6.

## Acceptance

| Card acceptance line | Where | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Add a field to an object: nothing is written before Save; after Save it is live, no publish needed | #36597 | `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511` › an edit sends nothing until Save; Save writes the draft, then publishes |
| Cancel/Save sit at the top-bar right where Publish was; hidden with no edit | #36597 | `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511`, `studioSaveBar.partialSave-36511` › is drawn only while a buffer is dirty |
| A field, the display name in Settings and a validation, one Save: all three live | #36597 | `studioSaveBar.partialSave-36511` › sends every dirty buffer in order; `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511` |
| Drag a field in the field layout: nothing written before Save; Cancel puts the canvas back | this PR | `DataPillar.layoutSaveCancel-36511` (2 tests) |
| Validations, actions, settings, hooks, permissions: each edit saved is live; no Draft chip, no Changes/Publish | #36597, #36634, this PR | `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511`, `ObjectHooksPanel.saveCancel-36511`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.studioSave-36511`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel*`, `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511` › with no draft pending |
| Create a flow and save; switch it on: live with no publish | #36634, this PR | `AutomationsPillar.saveCancel-36511` › the switch is live at once; a new flow is published as it is created |
| Delete a field and save: a confirm names the consequence | #36597 | `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511` › removing a published field asks at Save; `DataPillar.destructiveChange-34931` |
| Save something that uses an unsaved new field: refused, says which item to save first, edits kept | #36597 | `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511` › an edit that cannot be sent yet holds the whole Save and names what it needs; a refused publish keeps the edits unsaved |
| AI left a draft: notice shows; 「放弃 AI 的改动」 goes back to live; Changes count drops | this PR | `DataPillar.aiDraftDiscard-36511` (4 tests), `AutomationsPillar.saveCancel-36511` › flow AI block (2 tests) |
| HotCRM object: an edit is saved and live; visible in `/customizations` | #36597, #36634 | `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575`, `DataPillar.pairActions-30088` (writes the `.custom` pair, then publishes there) |
| A person mid-edit while the AI edits the same item: say what happens | this PR (below) | `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773` |
| The PR body lists every editor changed and every test retired or rewritten | each PR | lists below |

**A person and the AI edit the same item at once.** Neither side's change is dropped silently:

- The page keeps the person's edits in its buffer until Save. The AI's write goes to the item's draft on the server.
- On Save, the draft write carries the version the page read (`If-Match`, or `If-None-Match: *` when the page read no draft). If the AI wrote in between, the server refuses with a version conflict, and the existing draft-conflict dialog opens.
- The dialog offers **overwrite**. It asks once more, then sends the page's version pinned to the version the refusal served, and that version goes live.
- It also offers **reload**: the page takes what the AI saved, and the next Save is built on it.
- Nothing is written until the person picks one.
- `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773` pins the refusal and both choices (the "two editors", "reload" and "overwrite" cases).

## Editors changed in this PR

- `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`: permission sets in Studio.
- `studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`: org-wide default overview.
- `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: object / flow / permission creates; the object and flow AI notice and discard.
- New `studio-design/StudioAiDraftNotice.tsx`: the flow page's notice line.
- Field layout: no code change; pinned by a test.

  - `layersUnsaved-11799`: its FRESH layers count goes from 0 to 1, the publish.
  - `sharedSelect-11865` and `refusalClearsOnRevert-26846`: a "disabled Save" now reads as "no Save drawn".
- `StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787` now drives Create app, which still writes a draft. A permission set no longer leaves one.

## Acceptance notes

- Item 6 is wired for **objects and flows**: the pages that read the draft's per-change provenance (`draftChanges[].by`). Hooks, actions and permission sets do not read it, so they show no AI line. Their draft still opens and is saved live as the AI's version plus the person's edit. Adding that read is a separate change if wanted.
- The merge from `main` (13714286f) also carries one changeset wording edit. `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel.md` now says permission sets moved to Save in a later change.
- `DataPillar.panelHold-27629` failed once in an earlier full local run of the studio-design tests. It passes when run alone, and it passed in the final full run above. It looks like a timing flake under load, in code this PR does not touch.

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is the allowed Chinese channel).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
